info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Mortgage Loans Documents-v3-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loans Document Retrieval API enables users to access and retrieve documents associated with mortgage loans. This functionality is essential for lenders, brokers, and real estate professionals who require quick access to important loan documentation. By utilizing this API, consumers can efficiently gather necessary documents for processing and compliance purposes. The API streamlines the document management process, ensuring that users can easily obtain relevant loan documents as needed.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the documents associated with loans. It provides the necessary information regarding the documents necessary for loan processing.

requestBody.description: This request body is required to initiate a retrieval of loan documents. It should contain the necessary parameters in JSON format, as defined by the schema. Ensure that all required fields are accurately filled to facilitate the retrieval process.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of loan documents.

ListMortgageLoansDocumentsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the operation that retrieves loan document information.

status.description: Indicates the success status of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for tracking the request.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation's result.

audit.description: Details regarding the audit of the operation.

ListMortgageLoansDocumentsResponse_200.description: Response schema for the successful operation of retrieving loan document information.

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the operation.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the operation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.

Audit.description: Audit information related to the operation, including creator details and timestamp.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
